create.name: Clive Freeman
create.bio:
Clive Freeman is a meditation teacher who runs Present Minutes, a small project about carrying the calm of formal practice into ordinary, busy days. His starting point is that most of us cannot live on a quiet beach, so the work is to fit attention and kindness around jobs, children, inboxes and long to-do lists. He writes in a friendly, personal voice, drawing on Buddhist ideas such as loving-kindness and equanimity, on non-dual teaching, and on books he has returned to over decades, among them Douglas Harding's On Having No Head and Culadasa's The Mind Illuminated.

He has recorded a set of free guided meditations, from ten-minute body scans, breath practices and loving-kindness sessions to longer sits that train awareness of one's own thinking, along with yoga nidra style relaxation. He also teaches regular meditation and mindfulness sessions online by video, open to people in any country, and has lately been teaching the 24-movement Tai Chi form, which he presents as a moving meditation. His blog ranges from chess ratings and household chores to doubt and change, always asking how a few present minutes can shift the rest of the day.

courses.title: Meditation and Mindfulness Sessions on Zoom
courses.description: Regular group meditation and mindfulness sessions he leads by video call for people in any country. Those interested are asked to write to him by email to join.

free_resources.title: Clive Freeman on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His teacher page on the free Insight Timer app, where his recorded guided meditations can be played.

free_resources.title: Ten Minute Guided Body Scan
free_resources.description: A short recorded body scan for beginners, moving attention slowly through the body. Free to play from his guided meditations page.

free_resources.title: Ten Minute Guided Breath Meditation
free_resources.description: A beginner's recording that rests attention on the breath for ten minutes. Free to play from his guided meditations page.

free_resources.title: Ten Minute Guided Loving-Kindness Meditation
free_resources.description: A short loving-kindness practice for newcomers, wishing goodwill to oneself and others. Free to play from his guided meditations page.

free_resources.title: Twenty Minute Guided Meditation with Checking In
free_resources.description: A longer sit with pauses for noticing what the mind is doing, aimed at building awareness of one's own thinking. Free to play from his guided meditations page.
